_comment: Routing fixtures for the intent classifier (UNIVERSAL-PLANNING UP-R13.1).
The deployment bar is >=85% accuracy on THIS file, and the file is the point: a heuristic
classifier tuned against the same examples that measure it reports its own training set back.
So these are deliberately phrased the way a user actually types — lowercase, abbreviated,
missing the keywords the classifier hopes for — and the file carries cases the heuristics were
`why` is not decoration: when a fixture fails, the next person needs to know whether the
classifier is wrong or the fixture's expectation is.

cases.intent: fix the typo in the readme
cases.why: one word changed in one file

cases.intent: what does the frontier function do
cases.why: a question, not work

cases.intent: add a comment explaining the cache key
cases.why: a single well-specified edit

cases.intent: bump the lockfile
cases.why: mechanical

cases.intent: show me the failing tests
cases.why: a read

cases.intent: rename config_dir to home_dir everywhere it's used
cases.why: mechanical but wide — a rename across a codebase is scoped, not trivial

cases.intent: the build is broken and blocking everyone, unblock it
cases.why: time pressure vetoes the deep path however messy the cause

cases.intent: asap: revert the last deploy
cases.why: urgent AND irreversible — pressure still wins, the gate does the protecting

cases.intent: hotfix the null check in the auth handler
cases.why: high stakes, small and specified: gate it, do not grill it

cases.intent: add a retry to the ingest queue
cases.why: real work, no unusual risk or unknowns

cases.intent: write the changelog entry for this release
cases.why: stakes are high (release) but this is ordinary authoring

cases.intent: split the settings page into tabs
cases.why: moderate scope, clear intent

cases.intent: look into why the sync job is slow lately
cases.why: uncertain but narrow — an investigation, not a program

cases.intent: evaluate whether we should adopt uv instead of pip
cases.why: a comparison with a bounded answer

cases.intent: figure out why memory keeps growing and rearchitect the cache to fix it
cases.why: complex AND uncertain — the canonical deep case

cases.intent: port the whole ingestion pipeline to the new provider interface
cases.why: broad structural change

cases.intent: revoke and reissue every API credential in production
cases.why: irreversible on a consequential target

cases.intent: purge the customer analytics table
cases.why: irreversible, high-stakes target, and perfectly clear — clarity is why it is dangerous

cases.intent: redesign how we do auth across the desktop app and the gateway
cases.why: complex, uncertain, and security-shaped

cases.intent: keep an eye on the error rate and tell me if it spikes
cases.why: monitor-shaped: the planner should emit a watcher, not a one-shot

cases.intent: triage these fifteen open issues
cases.why: a known decision tree, not an agentic loop

cases.intent: review this diff for security problems
cases.why: review-shaped

cases.intent: postgres vs sqlite for this
cases.why: comparison-shaped, and phrased the way someone actually types it
